variants: Mind if I walk with you for a bit?
followups: How are you finding it so far?
Did you sleep OK last night?
Is this your first Camino?
tips_zh: 回答寒暄不用讲细节，比如 "Good, thanks! A bit tired. You?"

followups: What's it like living in Beijing?
Have you been to Europe before?
How long was the flight?

listen.zh: 澳大利亚人 / 新西兰人

listen.en: I'm from the States. / I'm from Ohio.
listen.note: 美国人常直接报州名或城市名

listen.zh: 英格兰 / 苏格兰 / 威尔士
加泰罗尼亚人 / 巴斯克人 / 加利西亚人

listen.en: I'm originally from X, but I live in Y.
listen.zh: 老家在 X，现在住在 Y

tips_zh: 答完一定要反问 "What about you?"

variants: What do you do for work?
What line of work are you in?
followups: What does that involve?
So what do those sensors actually do?
When do you start the new job?
How did you get so much time off?

listen.en: I work in tech / finance / healthcare.
listen.zh: 我在科技 / 金融 / 医疗行业

tips_zh: 准备一句大白话，讲清楚芯片和传感器是干什么用的，别用术语

A4.title_zh: 为什么走 Camino / 行程
A4.main_q: Why are you walking the Camino?
variants: What brings you to the Camino?
How long are you walking for?
followups: Is it a religious thing for you?
How did you hear about the Camino?
What's next after Santiago?
How long is your whole trip?
Where are you going in Italy?

listen.zh: 我从 St Jean 出发

listen.en: I'm doing the Francés / the Portuguese / the Norte.
listen.zh: 我走的是法国之路 / 葡萄牙之路 / 北方之路
走到 Santiago 后继续去菲尼斯特雷

tips_zh: 把"为什么来"准备成两三句话的小故事

A5.main_q: How far are you going today?
followups: What time did you set off this morning?
Did you see the sunrise?
Are you stopping in Portomarín?

A6.main_q: What do you do for fun?
variants: Have you done anything like this before?
followups: What's the highest mountain you've climbed?
Where did you travel before this?
What do you do on weekends in Beijing?
tips_zh: 准备两三个能展开聊的话题，比如登山、新疆自驾

A7.main_q: Can you use Google in China?
variants: Was it hard to get your visa?
What's the food like back home?
Do many Chinese people walk the Camino?
followups: What surprised you most about Spain?
What do you miss from home?
tips_zh: 简短、中性地回答，然后把话题转回对方，比如 "It's a bit complicated. Have you ever been to Asia?"
欧洲人最常用 WhatsApp，出发前装好

linda.name: Linda
linda.bio: a 62-year-old retired schoolteacher from Ohio, USA, walking the Camino from Sarria with her sister. Chatty and warm, and likes asking personal questions
linda.setting: on the trail from Sarria to Portomarín, walking side by side
linda.bio_zh: 62 岁，美国俄亥俄州退休教师，和姐姐一起从 Sarria 出发，爱聊天，爱问私人问题
linda.setting_zh: 从 Sarria 走往 Portomarín 的路上

jonas.name: Jonas
jonas.bio: a 24-year-old German student on a gap year who has walked all the way from León
jonas.setting: cooking pasta in the albergue kitchen in the evening
jonas.bio_zh: 24 岁，德国学生，正在空档年，从 León 走过来
jonas.setting_zh: 晚上在 albergue 厨房煮意面

siobhan.name: Siobhán
siobhan.bio: a 45-year-old nurse from Cork, Ireland. She talks fast and uses Irish expressions like "grand", "cheers" and "you alright?"
siobhan.setting: taking a morning break at a café on the Camino
siobhan.bio_zh: 45 岁，爱尔兰 Cork 的护士，语速快，爱用 grand、cheers、you alright?

carmen.name: Carmen
carmen.bio: the warden of a public (Xunta) albergue in Galicia. Her English is limited: very short sentences mixed with Spanish words
carmen.setting: at the albergue check-in desk; there are only a few beds left
carmen.bio_zh: 加利西亚一家公立 albergue 的管理员，英语有限，句子很短，夹杂西班牙语单词

marco.name: Marco
marco.bio: the receptionist at a hostel in Florence; efficient and polite
marco.setting: checking the learner in, but there is a problem with the booking dates
marco.bio_zh: 佛罗伦萨一家青旅的前台，高效、礼貌
marco.setting_zh: 办入住，预订日期出了问题

jiwoo.name: Ji-woo
jiwoo.bio: a 29-year-old Korean pilgrim, friendly and curious about China
jiwoo.setting: at the communal dinner table in an albergue
jiwoo.bio_zh: 29 岁，韩国朝圣者，友好，对中国好奇

clerk.name: Paolo
clerk.bio: a ticket clerk at Roma Termini station who speaks briskly
clerk.setting: at the ticket counter; the learner's train to Naples has been cancelled because of a strike
clerk.bio_zh: 罗马 Termini 火车站售票员，说话干脆
clerk.setting_zh: 你去那不勒斯的火车因为罢工取消了
